tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society No. 8, 6th Floor, Cunningham Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and condition as per tender document
The Bidder should be registered under Company Act Trust Act Societies Registration Act Partnership Act Proprietorship Act period of 5 years are eligible to apply No JV allowed

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidding firm should have successfully trained at least 5000+ students in a single order of Govt. Dept. Either through Offline/ Online for NEET,CET & JEE in any one year in the last 3 years, i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 for the students.
The students trained by the bidding firm must have secured 150 Govt. Free MBBS/ IIT/ NIT Seats in the last 3 year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.
The students trained by the bidding firm must have secured minimum 3000 Govt quota Seats for any professional courses in last 3 years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.

The bidding firm should have Experience of conducting Online Assessments of NEET/JEE/K-CET for students using TAB along with other Digital Learning Material for any Govt. Dept./Government Institutions at least for the 5000 students in the last 3 years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.

The bidding firm should have physical infrastructure studio for streaming of live sessions and subject faculty resources in full time basis in its own names. The physical or virtual verification of physical infrastructure and subject faculty resources in full time basis will be done
The bidding firm should have full time minimum 16 teaching faculty members working with the bidding firm of minimum of 5 years engaged in NEET/CET/JEE Training.

The bidding firm should have its own Online Platform on Android. Entire video lectures for each Subject wise, Chapter wise and concept wise should available to access. Online Test series with all the chapter wise test papers should be available in the online platform.

The bidding firm should have achieved a Cumulative turnover of atleast Rs.1600.00 Lakhs in the last 3 financial years and atleast Rs 800.00 Lakhs in any one financial year( 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26(Provisional)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
